title: Inventory shrink from stale feed
prompt: Recorded inventory shrink doubled this month. Determine why.
facts: Physical cycle counts show shrink unchanged from prior months.
The ERP on-hand denominator is missing receipts from one warehouse.
The affected warehouse represents 48% of monthly receipts.
The receipt interface failed intermittently for 11 days.
The shrink calculation uses ERP on-hand rather than physical count.
